sections.Profile:
The Apollo and Blast Off pinball machines were both manufactured by Williams in 1967 as part of their effort to capitalize on the excitement surrounding the NASA space program. Designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Art Stenholm, these electro-mechanical machines feature space exploration themes. Apollo was the replay version, while Blast Off was the add-a-ball version.

- Years made: 1967
